newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers bounce up, rest of Europe sags.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers bounce up, rest of Europe sags.

text.p: ARA fuel oil bunkers rose on Friday as barges swung up sharply from initial lows while prices in much of Europe weakened, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST was quoted at $100/$102 fob with barges trading at around $98/$99 fob ARA. Enquiry volume was reasonably healthy, but the figure was distorted by a single large enquiry of around 6,000 tonnes.
"If you set that aside, it's really rather quiet," one dealer said.
Hamburg bunker prices were weaker, responding to Rotterdam's late slip on Thursday.
Mediterranean bunkers were mostly $1/$2 a tonne lower. Many suppliers said buying was hectic as a number of shipowners felt the market had bottomed out in the short term.
Egyptian prices fell by $1 a tonne, while Fujairah was barely changed.
